visual_identity.core_identity: A low insectoid scavenger that seeks metal, recognized by its long sensory antennae, armored body, and metal-corroding feeding behavior.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low four-legged arthropod-like body, arched armored back, extremely long feeler antennae sweeping forward, tapered tail.
visual_identity.head_features: Small blunt head with simple mandibles and very long feathery or segmented antennae.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact low body on four sturdy legs with plated back and flexible tail, more alien than mammalian.
visual_identity.surface: Broad armor plates with restrained seam lines; antennae kept clean and readable.
must_avoid: six insect legs unless anatomy becomes cluttered

accuracy_checks: contact with metal clearly communicates corrosive feeding

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
